content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Asphalt, aggregate and mining equipment for road builders; no pump manufacturing or water customers."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Water meters and flow instruments measure water rather than move it; no pump products."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Microturbine power generation systems for onsite power; not pumps or fluid-moving equipment."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Roofing membranes, insulation and coatings for construction; no pump or water business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"MRO distributor that resells pumps and offers repair; it does not design or manufacture pumps."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Designs and manufactures high-pressure pumps and energy recovery devices for water plants, sold to water owners with aftermarket service."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Utility meters, test equipment, filters and aerospace parts; pumps are not a core product."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Plumbing, HVAC and waterworks distributor that buys from manufacturers; it does not manufacture pumps."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Designs and manufactures industrial pumps sold to plant operators with aftermarket parts and repair, though it also has friction and connector businesses."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Pre-insulated piping systems for district energy and pipelines; piping is not pump manufacturing."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Engines and generator sets for equipment makers; no pump products or water customers."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Specialty chemical process fluids and lubricants for metalworking; not pump manufacturing."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Heat tracing and process heating systems for plant operators; no pump products."},{"label":"C14","good":false,"reason":"Coding and marking printers plus water quality instruments and UV treatment; no pump manufacturing."}]}
